name: Tri Mhuilinn Gate
description: The timber gate in Trí Mhuilinn's southern palisade controls the main road into the village. By day it stands open amid ordinary traffic; after dark its narrow passage makes every late arrival conspicuous.
atmosphere: Heavy timbers, churned earth, and nowhere to pass without being noticed.
notes: Cream Tax uses this as the guarded entry point. Because horseshoes have vanished from village thresholds and the smithy, Village Guard - Prototype 01 stands here while Village Guard - Prototype 02 patrols Inside Palisade. The farms used by Milk and Feathers lie north and outside the palisade, so that Mission does not require passing this gate.
